title: Audit: crypto2dev-shim 2026-04-21 (pass 2)
description: Second-pass audit of wolfcrypt/src/port/crypto2dev/crypto2dev_port.c against all 10 sections of ~/PROMPT-audit-crypto2dev-shim.md. First pass (wolfssl-yjw epic) closed all 10 findings. This pass audits the current fixed code for residual gaps.
notes:
Confidence (Section 10):

Encrypt/decrypt parity: ~80% covered. Found one asymmetry (qsi.1: oversized-tag check fires post-encrypt on encrypt path, pre-acquire on decrypt path). CBC and CTR counter paths are symmetric. authTag==NULL with authTagSz>0 on encrypt is a silent no-op vs decrypt BUFFER_E — intentional per code comment; not filed separately.

devCtx lifecycle: ~85% covered. HMAC and ECC COPY paths not guarded (qsi.2, qsi.3) — triggering requires wolfSSL to dispatch wc_HmacCopy/wc_ecc_copy through CryptoCb COPY, which I could not verify without reading wolfSSL hmac.c/ecc.c. FREE paths (AES, hash, HMAC, ECC) look complete. Error-path leaks verified clean. Gaps: did not trace every possible partially-initialized devCtx path under malloc failure + re-entry.

FIPS minimums: ~85% covered. HMAC key minimum not enforced at SETKEY (qsi.4). AES key minimum is effectively enforced by wolfSSL software path (SETKEY returns CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE). ECC P-256 minimum enforced at SETKEY. GCM nonce and tag minimums enforced. RSA is CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE throughout.

Would raise confidence: (1) grep wolfSSL hmac.c and ecc.c for CryptoCb COPY dispatch to confirm qsi.2 and qsi.3 are reachable; (2) run test suite under ASAN to detect any double-free or use-after-free paths not caught by code review; (3) verify HMAC SETKEY return-code behavior in wc_HmacSetKey to confirm wolfSSL skips software validation when callback returns 0 (affects qsi.4 severity).
